name: av-dev
description: Experimental. Agent workflow for any repo: av-setup scans the repo and writes a team config, AI docs, per-skill overlays and role skills; av-plan, av-implement, av-review, av-verify and av-docs-sync then plan, implement, review and verify with evidence-backed gates. Pipeline slots run on Claude models chosen per slot; a gitignored local config overrides team settings per machine.
